description: A general-purpose application requiring standard identity verification, address proof, educational credentials, and a photograph.

requirements.name: Identity Proof
requirements.description: A valid government-issued identity document (passport, national ID card, or driver's license)

requirements.name: Address Proof
requirements.description: Recent utility bill, bank statement, or official letter showing current residential address (within last 3 months)

requirements.name: Date of Birth Verification
requirements.description: Date of birth must be verifiable from at least one official document

requirements.name: Recent Photograph
requirements.description: A recent passport-size color photograph (taken within last 6 months)

requirements.name: Educational Certificate
requirements.description: Highest educational qualification certificate or transcript

requirements.name: Employment Reference
requirements.description: Letter from current or most recent employer confirming employment status
